rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unencrypted Cardholder Data Transmission
rules.description: Detects transmission of cardholder data over unencrypted channels violating PCI-DSS Requirement 4
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_001", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Default Credentials in Cardholder Environment

rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pci%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dss%') AND "value" > 0
